verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly describe auto-crediting custodial accounts with optional auto-liquidation, accepting USDC and auto-converting to USD into a treasury, and sending fiat payouts via ACH/Fedwire/Swift/SEPA — directly matching the finance-lead's request to settle crypto receipts in fiat and avoid holding crypto on the books. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of the auto-liquidation flow in production, and clearer accounting/reconciliation documentation for finance teams.
